items.question: Can five-product differences be attributed to Harness independently of model and Skill?
items.known: The five-product source review covers all three S01 configurations per product. All 15 metadata records lack backend model attestation. Codex and DSH control only parts of Skill configuration; DSH r2/r3 have actual retained Skill calls. GUI complete Skill conditions remain unknown. Existing local boundary and permission observations do not establish independent five-product causality. On Oct24 a newly supported per-run local provider plus common MCP was executed on official Codex0.159.2 and DSH0.2.1-rc.2. Four main fixed-response tasks passed; the deterministic controller does not interpret Skill text. Codex still exposes a Skill header; full deletion is not claimed. Three GUI products and default neural-model task causality remain uncontrolled. Oct24 native GUI preflights for all three remaining products were completed. WorkBuddy supports a custom endpoint and local MCP, but three accepted calibrations remain unknown with no shared probe call. Yuanbao has no shared endpoint found in the inspected menus; Doubao custom connectors explicitly apply only to local computer, while the tested entrance is cloud computer. These are bounded interface observations, not proof of permanent product absence.
items.impact: Fixed generation/Skill-text action influence is removed for the executed two-product MCP contract; no pure five-product causal ranking or real-model quality inference.
items.next_action: Do not repeat completed GUI preflights. Obtain actual supported WorkBuddy ToolSearch schema constraints before a new registered diagnostic/calibration; at most one new protocol and one calibration under next-week P05. For Yuanbao/Doubao cloud, reopen only with new supported interface evidence.
items.stop_condition: The four C/D main arms are complete and remain bounded component evidence. All three WorkBuddy calibrations are archived unknown. Stop further WorkBuddy attempts until sufficient actual schema evidence exists; stop Yuanbao/Doubao cloud common-endpoint work at the documented interface limits. No default-model or complete-Skill inference.

No external reproduction feedback was available when preparing the Oct25 draft; the Oct24 review deadline did not establish completion.

items.known: A normal close command was sent, but the immediately collected inventory still listed WorkBuddy. Launch occurred before an absent-window observation. Final bytes pass; this does not establish the intended intervention.
items.impact: W02 validity and paired effect stay unknown; not a product failure or a valid intervention success.

items.question: Were the originally attached bytes preserved in product-managed storage across the reopening commands?
items.known: V2 before/after native Save As retrieved the original message attachment and existing Stage A bytes in both arms, before a new operator model submission. Host source and local outputs remained present. This establishes the bounded local UI retrieval, not independent product-managed cloud storage.
items.impact: Attachment-card continuity and collected output correctness are separate from stored-attachment byte preservation; do not award zero/full marks for unknown storage bytes.
items.next_action: Keep the local UI retrieval result separate from cloud storage. Reopen the cloud question only if an official retrieval/provenance interface can distinguish a product-managed independent copy from the retained host source; preregister before any new task.
items.stop_condition: The current interface and retained-host-source design do not isolate cloud storage. Stop this metric in the current batch; do not repeat tasks, infer from model recall or convert it into a score.
